listen_address.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)

port.description: TCP port for incoming client connections

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed

enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for client connections

certificate_path.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format)

key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format)

method.description: Authentication method: 'none' = open access, 'password' = file-based, 'ldap' = directory-based

password_file.description: Path to password file (HMAC-SHA256 hashed passwords, one per line: username:hash)

url.description: LDAP server URL (e.g., ldap://ldap.example.com:389 or ldaps:// for SSL)

bind_dn.description: DN used to bind to the LDAP server for user lookup

bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind account (store securely in production)

filter.description: LDAP filter for user lookup (%s replaced with username)

user_attribute.description: LDAP attribute used as the username identifier

session_timeout.description: Session timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout)

enabled.description: Persist documents to disk after session ends

max_doc_size.description: Maximum document size in bytes (10 MB default)

log_file.description: Path to log file (empty string = log to stderr)

groups.description: Predefined document groups with access control

name.description: Unique group name (used as prefix in group_{{i}}_name keys)

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the group

members.description: List of usernames allowed in this group

hostname.description: Public hostname/FQDN for WebSocket/SSE fallback (e.g., gobby.example.com)

enabled.description: Enable WebSocket support for real-time collaboration
